ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: As shown in the figure, a liquid butane ($C_4H_{10}$) sample in a pressurized lighter is placed directly below an aluminum can. It is known that the total mass of butane is 0.51 g, the specific heat capacity of water is 4.18 J/(g·°C), and the density of water is 1.00 g/mL. Please calculate the heat absorbed by the water (unit: kJ).

According to significant figures, it is taken as approximately 24 kJ.

method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中可见一个铝制罐放在铁圈支架上的金属网/石棉网上方，罐的下方正对着一个丁烷打火机，旁边标注有“Aluminum can”和“butane lighter”。
推理：题目要求计算水吸收的热量，使用 q = mcΔT。水的体积为 100.0 mL，密度为 1.00 g/mL，所以水的质量 m = 100.0 mL × 1.00 g/mL = 100.0 g。水温从 25.0°C 升至 82.3°C，所以 ΔT = 82.3 - 25.0 = 57.3°C。水的比热容 c = 4.18 J/(g·°C)，因此 q = 100.0 × 4.18 × 57.3 J = 23951.4 J = 23.9514 kJ。按有效数字取约为 24 kJ。
